name: Orphan Child (Human Child Expert 2)
body:
Small children reeking of fish toil away with their pitchforks, stabbing fish parts and throwing them into chutes leading into a foul smelling vat

Orphan Child
CR 1/3

XP 135
Human child expert 2
N Small humanoid
Init +3; Senses Perception -1

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 11 (+3 Dex, +1 size)
hp 9 (2d8)
Fort +0, Ref +3, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee dagger +0 (1d3-2/19-20) or pitchfork +0 (1d6-2)

TACTICS

The orphans avoid combat, but if pressed to fight or otherwise compelled, they attack with their pitchforks. An orphan who takes any damage usually attempts to flee. They attempt to flee at every opportune moment in combat.

STATISTICS

Str 7, Dex 17, Con 10, Int 9, Wis 8, Cha 10
Base Atk +1; CMB -2; CMD 11
Feats Skill Focus (Sleight of Hand), Stealthy
Skills Acrobatics +8, Bluff +5, Climb +3, Escape Artist +10, Sleight of Hand +11, Stealth +14
Languages common
Combat Gear dagger or pitchfork
